retail_family_rows.name: Large retail destinations
retail_family_rows.target_plan_decision: Retain seven actual market/book/tailor/maker/parcel/florist/bakery destinations; compose a real focal activity and connected frontage.
retail_family_rows.target_section_or_threshold_decision: Use deep thresholds, stepped fitted counters and related ceilings to reveal activity from the street.
retail_family_rows.original_asset_work: Original stock, packaging, working surfaces and service fixtures appropriate to each destination.
retail_family_rows.material_and_fixture_work: Materials distinguish paper, textile, plant and bakery use through medium patterns and task light.
retail_family_rows.current_function: Ambient shopping exists in seven large rooms, making 107 shopping destinations with small shops.
retail_family_rows.remaining_function_or_capacity_work: No full merchant labor, production, stock scarcity or distinct service-capacity proof. Bakery is not automatically a D10 meal venue.
retail_family_rows.verification_rule: Inspect and test each changed profile and all affected stable IDs. Family reuse never grants automatic art, function, clearance or persistence acceptance.

retail_family_rows.name: Addressed storefronts
retail_family_rows.target_plan_decision: Preserve R001–R100 in their 100 existing 12 x 12 m allocations; form recessed entry, angled display and a real browsing/service loop.
retail_family_rows.target_section_or_threshold_decision: Vary threshold depth, showcase/ceiling profile and fitted counter according to a small approved family of store types.
retail_family_rows.original_asset_work: Original merchant/display/parcel fittings with distinct goods silhouettes and a few authored names/graphic motifs.
retail_family_rows.material_and_fixture_work: Display, counter and entry sources have separate jobs; coordinated fascia and tactile finishes, not identical glowing door frames.
retail_family_rows.current_function: All 100 have stable IDs and ambient browsing/purchase/parcel behavior; goods still repeat.
retail_family_rows.remaining_function_or_capacity_work: Shop-specific goods/use, seller interaction, occupancy and physical restocking/delivery routes remain shallow or absent.
retail_family_rows.verification_rule: Inspect and test each changed profile and all affected stable IDs. Family reuse never grants automatic art, function, clearance or persistence acceptance.

REGISTRY_NOW.method: Single external data-only script instantiates ship.gd, calls register_rooms/register_meal_seats, serializes dictionaries, frees the object. It never enters the scene tree, builds geometry, loads main.tscn or advances simulation.
REGISTRY_NOW.result: 1462 unique IDs, 18 decks, 1000 guest units, 2000 guest berths, 400 crew berths; registry data exactly matches revision03.

SPATIAL_ALL.scope: All 1462 recorded center/foyer routes, portal alignment/open/closed screens and sampled support; no per-room rendered or dynamic cart walkthrough.
SPATIAL_ALL.result: 1462 ordinary routes and sampled floors pass; 25 broad-body routes failed at that historical snapshot. Later D09 and crew checks have narrower superseding evidence.
SPATIAL_ALL.limits: These are historical facts. Do not subtract repaired samples to claim a fresh whole-ship pass.

D09_SPATIAL.scope: 110 D09 routes, 120 portals, 7990 support samples; salon eight activity and two care approaches; two terrace pockets; full tram reserve; one real spring-guided loaded-cart crossing.
D09_SPATIAL.result: Focused pass; three bottles retained across 1669 physics frames.
D09_SPATIAL.limits: No new full cleanup episode, every-bay parking, all appendages or final art approval. The lead confirms later profile/height changes do not alter this geometry; retained spatial pass remains applicable to unchanged modules. New art/geometry requires focused recheck.

CHANGE_SCOPE.source: Implementation owner clarification, 2026-10-01 02:54 UTC, plus retained main-scene result inspection
CHANGE_SCOPE.result: Post-review ship/full_game changes add profile-save recovery and correct upper-floor incident display height; the reviewed D09 geometry is unchanged.
CHANGE_SCOPE.rule: Whole-file hash changes identify a new source snapshot but do not invalidate unrelated module evidence. Recheck only changed geometry/routes, affected behavior, interfaces and dependent areas. New art integration requires focused render/physical review.

PROFILE_PERSISTENCE.scope: ConfigFile old-profile import cases, population/home preservation, claimed partial event migration, idempotence and full original guest regression.

PROFILE_PERSISTENCE.limits: Not per-room collision, every prop/wallet/partial-dirt integration or every family migration acceptance.
